'''''Platycerium hillii''''' is a [[species]] of [[staghorn fern]] in the genus ''[[Platycerium]]''. It is found in [[Australia]].<ref>{{cite book|last1=Benzing|first1=David H.|title=Vascular Epiphytes: General Biology and Related Biota|date=2008|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=9780521048958|page=211|language=en}}</ref>
